subject: Lakemont private deployment: ops handoff & connectivity cadence
messages:
From: Rajeev Gupta <rajeev.gupta@lakemont.ai>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: emily.zhao@lakemont.ai, procurement@lakemont.ai
Date: 2028-04-19 09:12 -0700
Subject: Private deployment scope & initial timeline

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Lakemont is excited to move forward with a private deployment (VPC peering + private endpoints) for our internal clinical summarization workload. Emily and I put together an initial set of requirements and a preferred cutover window (end of May). Key asks:

- VPC peering with strict egress controls to our subnets
- Private endpoints for API traffic (no public ingress)
- On-prem package option for our air-gapped analytic cluster (we may stage in a DMZ)
- SOC2 evidence & network diagrams for procurement

I attached the high-level requirements PDF. Can Redwood share a suggested preflight checklist and an operations handoff cadence so our network and security teams can align?

Best,
Rajeev
Director, IT Infrastructure
Lakemont Therapeutics
(attachment: lakemont_onprem_requirements.pdf)

From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
To: Rajeev Gupta <rajeev.gupta@lakemont.ai>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-19 11:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment scope & initial timeline

Hi Rajeev — great to meet you and thanks for the doc.

High level: we can support VPC peering + private endpoints and the on-prem package for air-gapped sites. Next steps I propose:

1) Preflight meeting with network & security (60 min) — discuss subnets, route tables, allowed egress, and HSM/KMS patterns
2) Share Redwood preflight checklist and runbook draft (I attached the runbook and checklist)
3) Technical validation window (staging) followed by a production cutover plan and canary rollout

Can Monica (solutions lead) and Marcus (runtime ops) join the preflight meeting — they will own the network tests and package build respectively.

Proposed times: Tue 4/23 10am PT or Wed 4/24 2pm PT. Which works?

Sofia Ivanova
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
(attachments: runbook-lakemont-v1.md, redwood-private-preflight-checklist.xlsx)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai, Rajeev Gupta <rajeev.gupta@lakemont.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-19 14:20 -0700
Subject: RE: Private deployment scope & initial timeline — preflight agenda

Thanks — looping in a quick agenda so security and network know what to expect.

Agenda (60m)
- 0-10m: Introductions & deployment goals (Sofia/Rajeev)
- 10-25m: VPC peering topology & routing (Rajeev + Lakemont network lead)
- 25-40m: Private endpoint auth (mutual TLS / certs) and KMS integration (Laura)
- 40-50m: On-prem package constraints (airgap, proxy pattern) (Marcus)
- 50-60m: Acceptance criteria & next milestones (deliverables and owners)

Preflight tests we typically run:
- BGP/Static route verification and no-public-route enforcement
- TCP handshake and TLS validation to private endpoints
- KV cache sizing and perf smoke test in staging
- Package install script dry-run (on a VM)

Rajeev — can you share your CIDR blocks, expected egress IPs, and the name/email of your network engineer so we can add them to the invite?

--Monica
Solutions Engineering Lead
Redwood Inference

From: AHS Procurement <procurement@lakemont.ai>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai, Rajeev Gupta <rajeev.gupta@lakemont.ai>
Date: 2028-04-21 08:47 -0700
Subject: Lakemont / Redwood: SOC2 artifacts & contract timing

Hi Sofia,

Procurement here — to keep the procurement timeline (target signature by 5/10) we need the following items:

- SOC2 Type II report (or interim bridge letter)
- Data retention & deletion policy for private deployments
- Basic network diagram showing peering endpoints and egress controls

If you can push the SOC2 PDF and a network diagram by 4/24, we can proceed to redlines and DocuSign. Thanks.

Regards,
AHS Procurement
procurement@lakemont.ai

From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
To: AHS Procurement <procurement@lakemont.ai>, Rajeev Gupta <rajeev.gupta@lakemont.ai>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-25 16:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Lakemont / Redwood: SOC2 artifacts & contract timing

Thanks — attaching the SOC2 redacted PDF and a network diagram export for your packet. Also including the preflight checklist and runbook we discussed.

Deliverables attached:
- redwood_SOC2_typeII_redacted.pdf
- lakemont_network_diagram_v1.png
- redwood-private-preflight-checklist.xlsx (version noted)
- runbook-lakemont-v1.md (installation + test steps)

Next milestones:
- 4/26: Procurement confirms redlines & issues DocuSign prefill
- 5/03-5/10: Staging validation window (engineering-runbook smoke tests)
- 5/24-5/28: Production cutover (canary -> roll to full capacity)

Rajeev — Monica and Marcus will schedule the preflight meeting for 4/24 2pm PT unless you prefer the earlier slot. Please confirm your network contact and CIDR info in reply.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
(attachments: redwood_SOC2_typeII_redacted.pdf, lakemont_network_diagram_v1.png)
